grh_a102ae85af0cda25c4a0.title: Criss Cross
paragraphs: Armored-truck driver Steve Thompson cannot let go of his former lover Anna, even after she marries gangster Slim Dundee. When Slim discovers them together, Steve invents an armored-car robbery to explain the meeting and secretly plans to use the heist to escape with Anna. The robbery kills an old guard and leaves Steve wounded, while Slim survives and sends gunman Vincent to finish him. Steve bribes Vincent to take him to Anna, only to discover that her promises were driven by money and self-preservation. Slim arrives at the hideout as Anna turns back to Steve for protection, and the final confrontation ends in gunfire just as police close in. Steveâ€™s detective friend Pete can only tell him that Anna was poison and that some men have to learn the truth the hard way.

Other credited names include Jimmy Wallington as announcer.

grh_a1bd085bd970f1414925.title: The Guys on the Ground
paragraphs: A framed collection of dramatized accounts from Alfred Friendly's The Guys on the Ground honors the Air Force service crews who keep combat aircraft operating. Three pilots relaxing after a bond rally tell a reporter about mechanics, engineers and other ground personnel building runways, repairing damaged planes under fire and working for days without rest. The program emphasizes that celebrated air victories depend on largely anonymous crews whose motto is that the difficult is done immediately and the impossible merely takes longer.

grh_a1ecdf9b7728a197f9be.title: The Understudy
paragraphs: Actor Carl has spent months understudying the lead in a successful play, studying every scene while watching someone else receive the applause. Even after the production moves uptown, his chance never comes, and by the show's final days he is drinking and talking as though his acting life has reached a dead end. Then, only minutes before curtain, the star calls in with laryngitis. Carl initially recoils from the chance he has wanted for so long, but realizes that refusing would end his career. He finally goes onstage, embracing the actor's creed that the show must go on.
